description: This file provides Thai localization (i18n) strings for the Select2 plugin, version 4.0.6-rc.1. It defines messages for error handling, input length constraints, loading indicators, maximum selections, no result indications, and search status.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when data cannot be loaded.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message instructing the user to remove a certain number of characters when input exceeds the maximum length.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to type more characters when input is too short.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message indicating more data is being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of items that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message displayed while searching.
